title: 4,000 Ships Sail for Japan. Then the Wind Changes #history
description:
1281: Kublai Khan sends one of history's biggest fleets against Japan. A new stone wall, samurai night raids, rushed river boats, and then the typhoon Japan called kamikaze, the divine wind. Told from inside the story, in under a minute.
